documentation only: docs/RUNFILES_TREES.md (new), docs/RUNFILES.md, docs/RUN_ENVIRONMENT_INFO.md, docs/ACTIONS_PARAMS.md, docs/BAZELRC.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/capabilities.json (embedded by `capabilities`), README.md, artifacts/PROGRESS.md; no source or test change after the capture.

post-review source change (no recapture): the executable sibling next to <name>.runfiles is a hardlink of the executable's content-addressed blob instead of a symlink (src/action.rs; manifest field sibling_file with digest and mode), so /proc/self/exe and realpath($0) resolve next to the tree like Bazel; captured observations are unaffected (the capture normalizes argv0 via $BUILD_EXECROOT and never read the sibling's link target). New test executable_sibling_resolves_proc_self_exe_and_realpath_to_its_runfiles.

post-review source change (no recapture): the transitive-repository map behind <exe>.repo_mapping is keyed by configured target (src/engine.rs dependency_repositories, rule-transition delegation followed) instead of by label, so select() differences between configurations give each configuration its own source-repository lines; the capture fixture analyzes every target in one configuration, so its rows are unaffected. New test repo_mapping_source_repositories_follow_each_configuration (verified to fail with the previous label-keyed union).
post-review docs: docs/RUNFILES_TREES.md and docs/capabilities.json describe both changes.
